w5backups_intro: After each local backup, the same file is uploaded to these destinations. A failed upload never affects the local copy.
w5backups_read_error: The off-site destinations could not be read
w5backups_empty: No destination yet. Add an S3 bucket, a WebDAV folder or an SFTP server to keep copies off this machine.
w5backups_never: Nothing uploaded yet: the next local backup will be.
w5backups_hostkey_unknown: The host key of this server is not confirmed yet, so nothing was sent. Check that the fingerprint below is the server's own (ssh-keygen -lf on the server), then confirm it.
w5backups_hostkey_changed: This server presented another host key than the one you confirmed, so nothing was sent. If the server was reinstalled, confirm the new key; otherwise something may be impersonating it.
w5backups_action_error: The action did not go through
w5backups_form_keep_help: Older copies at this destination are deleted beyond this number. No other file there is ever touched.
w5backups_form_include_key_warning: Whoever can read this destination can then decrypt every stored credential. Without the key, keep secret.key somewhere safe yourself, or the copies there cannot be restored with their credentials.
w5backups_form_secret_saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
w5backups_form_secrets_replace: A password or key typed here replaces the saved ones; leave both empty to keep them.
w5backups_form_save_error: The destination could not be saved
w5backups_s3_endpoint_help: Leave empty for AWS. For MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi or Cloudflare R2, the server address given by the provider.
w5backups_s3_region_help: Leave empty for us-east-1. Cloudflare R2 uses auto.
w5backups_s3_prefix_help: Optional. Use one folder per DumbMonit instance: old copies are pruned within it.
w5backups_s3_path_style_help: Needed by MinIO and most self-hosted servers, and by any endpoint given as an IP address.
w5backups_webdav_url_help: The folder must exist. On Nextcloud: https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/Backups.
w5backups_webdav_password_help: On Nextcloud, use an app password.
w5backups_sftp_directory_help: Leave empty for the account's home folder. The folder must exist.
w5backups_sftp_host_key_help: Optional: SHA256:… as ssh-keygen -lf prints it. Left empty, the test shows the server's fingerprint for you to confirm.
w5backups_sftp_auth_help: Enter a password, a private key, or both.
w5backups_sftp_private_key_help: Ed25519 or ECDSA, in OpenSSH format. RSA keys are refused.
w5backups_section_destinations: Off-site backup destinations and their credentials.
